title: THORChain confirms $10M exploit, rolls out recovery portal for affected users
summary: THORChain has launched a recovery portal following a $10 million exploit, allowing affected users across four chains to revoke malicious approvals and claim refunds.

title: Sharplink CEO points out 3 catalysts for Ethereum's price to surge higher

title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs bleed $1B in a week, snapping six-week inflow run
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $1 billion in a single week as capital rotated toward AI stocks and macro uncertainty weighed on sentiment, ending a six-week run that had pulled in $3.4 billion.

title: US CLARITY Act brings ‘major spike of euphoria’ to Bitcoin: Santiment

title: House committee leaders urge Trump to nominate CFTC members, citing CLARITY Act
